record.body:
## Evidence

.canon/config.json settings.conductor.phase_gate.suite.command ends with 'uv run pytest -q tests --ignore=tests/canon --ignore=tests/tuner -m tmux'. No test carries the tmux marker after remove-textual.

## Consequence

The advisory suite fails at the last step for every later phase, although all tests pass. The README Testing section and tests/test_tiered_verification.py also name the tmux pass.

## Follow-up

Edit the suite command in .canon/config.json to drop the tmux pass. Then update the README Testing section and tests/test_tiered_verification.py to match.

payload.basis: remove-textual deleted the tmux marker and the tmux tests. The command ends with pytest -m tmux, which exits 5 when it collects nothing, so a full suite run fails at that step. A human changes settings.conductor.phase_gate in .canon/config.json.
payload.claim: The phase suite command in .canon/config.json still runs a tmux pass that now selects no tests
payload.invalidated_when: A human removes the tmux pass from the suite command and the README Testing section and tests/test_tiered_verification.py agree

record.subject: suite-command-tmux-pass
